Marketer.com | https://marketer.com/manta | Remote or Onsite | Oslo, Norway

Marketer.com is a Norwegian company established in 2016. Manta is a new project we started building last year as part of Marketer.

We are building Manta to be a full-stack, trustable and auditable AI CMO agent.

This includes deploying state-of-the-art per-company infrastructure distributed globally close to customers for optimal latency. Our in-house Context Graph architecture requires hundreds of gigabytes of RAM per host to reason over underlying datasets, which demands cost-efficient deployments and extensive monitoring.

By combining edge computing with dedicated server and on-prem hosting, we aim to deliver strong performance while maintaining data privacy.

This creates interesting engineering challenges around large-scale data processing, distributed systems, and high-performance infrastructure.
